$comment: The official plugins (the ones DeckPilot bundles) built here, and the permission policy each must keep (official/README.md). `plugins` are released (signed, one GitHub Release per version); `fixtures` are built, packaged, signed with throwaway keys and compared with DeckPilot's build in CI only, never released. `permissions` is the exact set of permission kinds a plugin's manifest may declare: anything else, and every plugin API 1.9 privileged kind while the gate is closed, fails tools/check-official.py, unless the plugin is `held` (a reason): then it is built, tested and compared, its package refused for those kinds, never released.

plugins.held: hostViews is a plugin API 1.9 privileged kind: no release until the security review of DeckPilot docs/marketplace/publisher-review-request.md opens the gate
